notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other blue creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Crackleburr and two other blue creatures you control by tapping them, adding {1}{U/R}{U/R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Crackleburr's second ability by paying {U/R}{U/R} and untapping it and the two blue creatures, targeting any creature.
Repeat.
